overview.description: The 7RCC Spot Bitcoin and Carbon Credit Futures ETF (BTCK) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the 7RCC Kaiko Bitcoin Carbon Credit index. The fund tracks an index of 80% spot Bitcoin (BTC) and 20% carbon credit futures, seeking BTC exposure while incorporating an environmentally responsible approach. The carbon credit futures reference emissions allowances under the EU ETS, CCA, and RGGI. BTCK was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Teucrium.
